explanation: fitdistrplus::fitdist MLE: the optimiser (Nelder-Mead on the untransformed parameters) evaluates the log-density at trial parameter values outside the support (negative shape/scale), which returns NaN and the warning; the search then moves back into the support. Only fits that converge are used (fitdist errors otherwise and the MME fallback or the next candidate is taken) and the marginal is chosen by AIC among converged fits.
action: Explained; no effect on the fitted values. Counted per call in logs/warnings.log.

pattern: ties should not be present for the one-sample Kolmogorov
explanation: Drought durations are whole months, so the one-sample KS test of the duration marginal has ties and its asymptotic p-value is approximate. The reported marginal goodness of fit uses parametric-bootstrap KS/AD p-values (gof_marg), which are valid with ties; this ks.test p is only a screening diagnostic.
action: Explained; inference uses the bootstrap p-values.

pattern: diag\(V\) had non-positive or NA entries
explanation: fitdistrplus::fitdist (negative binomial margin of the duration, bootstrap refits): the numerical Hessian at the MLE is not positive definite when the fitted size parameter is very large (the negative binomial approaches the Poisson), so the standard errors cannot be computed. Only the point estimates are used (margins and return periods); standard errors are never used.
